description: When a school introduces a digital tool, professional development that starts from a lesson goal in the teacher's subject, shows the tool doing that job, and has teachers plan and teach a lesson with follow-up support and time is expected to produce more purposeful classroom use than training on how the tool works alone; no claim in this wiki tests that comparison, the nearest evidence is survey associations and implementation reports, and one coach's report limits it by finding narrow step-by-step technical training necessary for uptake.
title: Professional development should guide teachers on integrating digital content and tools, not just offer technical know-how
